speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing a longstanding pruritic rash, numbness, and tingling on your palms. To narrow this down, I need to know: how long has this been going on, and have you noticed any changes in your fingernails or any recent new sexual partners?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your occupation, have you had direct skin contact with rice plants or handled any animals that might have had skin lesions? I need to know if the rash started after specific work activities to rule out an occupational exposure like dermatophytosis or a parasitic infection.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The combination of a pruritic rash, eyebrow/eyelash loss, and hypopigmented macules strongly suggests secondary syphilis. Have you noticed any sores on your genitals or in your mouth in the past year, or any unexplained weight loss?

REQUEST TEST: RPR
REQUEST TEST: VDRL

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since the syphilis tests are negative, the combination of eyebrow loss, hypopigmented macules, and palm paresthesia is highly suggestive of Hansen's disease (leprosy). I need to confirm this with a skin biopsy.

REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy
